A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''rancor''' was owned by [[Karagga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Bred]] from a long line of competitive battle rancors, the rancor was the champion of the battle pit at [[Karagga's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and sired a child named [[Bonethrasher]]. However, Bonethrasher [[Death/Legends|slew]] his father in combat at only seven [[Standard month/Legends|months]] old and went on to be the undisputed champion of Karagga's pit until he himself was killed<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bonethrasher's father was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Bonethrasher in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" /> The Codex entry was added to the game in [[2012]] as part of Game Update 1.1.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20120113-0|text=Game Update 1.1: 'Rise of the Rakghouls' Coming Jan. 17th!}}</ref>
